negative_controls.NC04: No incorrect NoSQL operator-injection claim against integer-parsed getUserById; threshold $where injection is a different, real issue.

duplicates_or_same_root_reports.note: DAO sink and route source are one unsafe threshold flow.
Same path-controlled object access described in handler and route.
Missing server-side admin check echoed in route, handler and template; hidden-field mutability alone is not a new vulnerability.
Storage and direct comparison describe the same password-handling flaw.
Several forms repeat the global missing csurf concern; browser/SameSite and origin conditions must be stated.

confirmed_false_claims.reason: Login template password value is never filled with a password by current handlers. displayLoginPage and both error branches explicitly pass password as an empty string. Finding infers sensitive echo solely from the template placeholder.

Wrong source-to-sink variable: profile's href uses firstNameSafeString, not doc.website. The website value is placed in a text input. An actual firstName href concern is separately reported at a04467f77eb027b5887c1506ed00615d.

Claim that lack of explicit httpOnly makes session cookie readable by XSS is false for locked express-session 1.15.6, whose Cookie constructor sets httpOnly=true. Other secure/resave concerns in the same finding need separate judgment.

The live-reload string is a development-only trusted script assembled from browser-normalized location.host. No attacker-controlled markup input is identified; document.write and its performance downside alone do not establish script injection.

severity_qualification.note: Open redirect is present, but this report shows phishing/navigation impact, not direct RCE, credential disclosure or privilege escalation. Critical ranking is not supported by its evidence.
CSRF depends on the relevant browser and same-site/origin situation; absent token middleware does not prove every cross-site attack succeeds.

other_findings_not_fully_validated: Library DOM/eval primitives need application call chains; package age/CVE claims need dependency/advisory checks; tutorial snippets and test credentials are not automatically production exposure. Self-profile form echo does not establish a recipient outside the authenticated owner. No overall precision is claimed across all 325 findings.
location_warning: The completed v1 result carries one invalid_output warning; inspect source locations before acting. Complete file accounting is distinct from finding accuracy and line-location quality.
limits: Known-case matching plus targeted static review only. No target app or exploit execution. Old partial-scope results are not used as evidence.
